title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff DevOps engineer reporting to the Senior Manager in the Engineering department. This role is crucial to our Engineering team, which has built the world’s largest cloud security platform and continues to expand its global footprint and services. You will own mission-critical functions including deployments, production operations, observability, monitoring and alerting, incident management, automation, and platform reliability. In this role, you will serve as a premier technical leader troubleshooting complex distributed systems, optimizing AWS environments, and advancing modern GitLab-based CI/CD practices to maximize system resiliency and engineering velocity.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

- Lead operational ownership for cloud-based products, overseeing deployments, production support, on-call escalations, and incident resolution

- Architect, manage, and optimize resilient container-based architectures utilizing AWS EKS, Kubernetes, and automated cloud infrastructure solutions

- Scale end-to-end observability, monitoring, and alerting frameworks across distributed systems to proactively detect anomalies and accelerate remediation

- Champion troubleshooting initiatives for high-severity challenges spanning distributed platforms, networking, Kubernetes clusters, and deployment pipelines

- Advance DevOps practices by designing and standardizing GitLab CI/CD pipelines, runners, release workflows, and automation frameworks

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- You are a strategic platform thinker with deep expertise in cloud operations, modern platform architecture, and distributed systems reliability.

- You are an accountable owner who takes full responsibility for production health, system performance, and operational excellence.

- You are an expert troubleshooter and technical leader who rapidly diagnoses complex incidents and implements sustainable, preventive solutions.

- You are an influential communicator and collaborator capable of driving technical direction and establishing cross-functional engineering standards.

- You navigate seamlessly between high-level architectural strategy and hands-on technical execution while championing continuous learning in modern cloud and AI-driven operations.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or applying AI-driven solutions within an engineering or operations domain

- 10+ years of relevant experience designing, operating, tuning, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems

- Deep hands-on expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, AWS EKS, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab, and Python

- Demonstrated experience building and operating robust observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational diagnostic solutions across cloud platforms

- Proven track record in advanced troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, container platforms, and CI/CD pipelines

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

- Recognized expertise in incident recovery, root-cause analysis, and preventive reliability engineering in high-scale cloud environments

- Demonstrated success in optimizing AWS environments for latency, throughput, resiliency, and cost efficiency

title: Staff Software Engineer, CV UX
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Over 1.7 billion people worldwide live with musculoskeletal pain — and Hinge Health is on a mission to help them move beyond it. Our TrueMotion computer vision technology turns everyday mobile devices into powerful motion-tracking tools, giving members real-time feedback and guidance as they work through personalized exercise therapy. The CV User Experience team is responsible for making that magic feel effortless: building deeply interactive, TrueMotion-driven features that monitor movement, coach performance, and track recovery progress.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as the technical leader for this team — someone who can architect end-to-end systems across mobile and backend, tackle complex scaling challenges, and raise the bar on engineering quality. If you're passionate about building high-quality software that directly improves people's health outcomes, this is your role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH

In your first 3 months:

 - Ramp into the CV User Experience stack (React Native, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, AWS) and build relationships with product managers, designers, data scientists, and computer vision scientists.

 - Deliver your first end-to-end feature while auditing the current architecture for scaling and performance bottlenecks.

 - Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

In your first 6 months:

 - Own and lead architectural discussions for TrueMotion-driven experiences, proactively identifying challenges and proposing innovative solutions to complex mobile and full-stack engineering problems.

 - Establish stronger system observability using Datadog and Sentry, improving monitoring, logging, and error tracking across the full stack.

 - Profile systems to stay ahead of scaling and performance bottlenecks, ensuring a fast, responsive mobile experience for users.

In your first year:

 - Act as the primary technical leader for the team's architecture — designing robust, end-to-end solutions including performant APIs, mobile application architecture, and data models that are the foundation for TrueMotion's next generation.

 - Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement through thoughtful code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

 - Every quarter, identify, propose, and execute a significant upgrade or innovative change to the team's workflow, tooling, or architecture.




WHO YOU ARE

 - A Force Multiplier: You don't just ship great code — you improve the team's overall architecture, developer tooling, and practices, making everyone around you more effective.

 - A Learn-it-all: You stay at the forefront of mobile development, computer vision UX, and AI-powered developer tools. You bring "only-now-possible" ideas to the team and turn them into shipped capabilities.

 - Accountable: You take owner-operator pride in your code in production. You meet commitments, estimate well, and don't stop before solving the last 10–20% where the messy edge cases lie.

 - A Trust Builder: You communicate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data science teams to align on shared goals. You explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is understandable and not condescending.

 - Hands-On Leader: You lead at all levels — architecting systems and writing code, reviewing PRs and mentoring engineers, thinking quarters ahead and unblocking teammates today.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - At minimum, 4 + years of professional software engineering experience

 - At minimum, a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or equivalent 

 - 3+ years of experience building and shipping mobile applications

 - 3+ years of experience with backend technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, or GraphQL

 - 2+ years of experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

 - Experience working in distributed systems and microservices architectures

 - Hands-on experience with generative AI tools to accelerate development workflows, improve code quality, and streamline debugging


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience building and shipping mobile applications using React Native

 - Experience with event-driven architectures and tools such as Apache Kafka

 - Proficiency with observability tools such as Datadog and Sentry

 - Strong understanding of system design principles, mobile application architecture, and CI/CD pipelines

 - Experience with computer vision–driven user experiences on mobile platforms

 - Demonstrated track record of mentoring engineers and leading architectural discussions across teams


HINGE HEALTH HYBRID MODEL

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 


ABOUT HINGE HEALTH

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com.

 


WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

 - Inclusive healthcare and benefits: On top of comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we offer employees and their family members help with gender-affirming care, tools for family and fertility planning, and travel reimbursements if healthcare isn’t available where you live.

 - Planning for the future: Start saving for the future with our traditional or Roth 401k retirement plan options which include a 2% company match.

 - Modern life stipends: Manage your own learning and development.

 - Grow with us: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 


CULTURE & ENGAGEMENT

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter.

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. https://www.hingehealth.com/about/personnel-and-candidate-privacy-policy/





Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com https://app.ashbyhq.com/admin/organizational-settings/theme#.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

Staff Software Engineer - ITAM and AI Cost

We're looking for a Staff Full Stack Developer to help build and scale our AI-powered tools for application development. You'll work at the intersection of UI, backend, and AI-driven engineering — architecting solutions that improve developer experience, expand platform capabilities, and drive engineering excellence across the team.

The Software Asset Management product(ITAM) empowers organizations to manage software licensing and compliance with precision. Our engineers build performance-efficient algorithms that help customers achieve the most accurate licensing position possible. You’ll be responsible for the full software development lifecycle—from design and implementation to testing and delivery—while partnering closely with product managers, architects, and quality engineers. Together, we improve product quality, efficiency, and performance. The SAM team is deeply aligned with company priorities and market expectations, delivering solutions that matter.

You will be building the next generation of AI Cost Management capabilities that help enterprises understand, govern, optimise, and control AI spending across large-scale AI ecosystems. The product provides visibility into AI consumption, cost attribution, budgeting, forecasting, spend controls, alerts, and vendor integrations across AI services such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, and future AI providers.
What You Get to Do in This Role
- Design and implement AI-Native product development, using cutting-edge technical approaches to deliver business value
- Build high-quality, clean, scalable, and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit Testing, etc.)
- Own your code from design through implementation, test automation, and delivery
- Collaborate with product managers to define feature sets that solve real customer problems
- Work with architects to shape product design and with QE to enhance quality and performance
- Contribute to new product features and enhance existing offerings
- Mentor peers and promote knowledge-sharing across the team

To be successful in this role you have:
- Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products. 
- Hands-on experience with columnar/analytical data stores (e.g., ClickHouse, Apache Druid, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Vertica), including schema design, partitioning, and query optimization for large-scale analytical workloads.
- Experience building and operating distributed data pipelines for high-volume ingestion, transformation, and reconciliation (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, or dbt).
- Experience creating dashboards and analytic reports with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. 
- Proficiency in Python, Java, or similar object-oriented languages. 
- Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue. 
- Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization 
- Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Playwright, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines 
- Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness. 
- Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack. 
- Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency. 
- Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems 
 
Why Join Us 
- Build and deliver high-impact AI Native products that powers digital experiences for millions of users. 
- Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation. 
- Work as AI Native engineer and us AI productivity and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability. 
- Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

Work Personas

description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Consumer - Risk)

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Risk Engineering team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build and optimize the systems that detect and prevent fraud, manage credit and market risk, and protect millions of users from financial threats in real time at crypto-market scale. You'll provide technical leadership for end-to-end projects, drive architectural decisions that shape our risk detection and mitigation systems, and deliver complex features from inception through production. Your work directly reduces financial loss and keeps Coinbase users safe.

What you'll do:

- Lead the design and delivery of complex risk platform features end-to-end, from architecture through implementation, deployment, and monitoring, with stringent requirements for correctness, performance, and reliability

- Drive architectural decisions that shape Coinbase's risk detection and mitigation systems, translating ambiguous business requirements into scalable working architectures that balance fraud prevention with user experience

- Partner cross-functionally with Data Science, ML, Risk Analysts, Product, and Compliance teams to build proactive systems (real-time decisioning engines, model-driven fraud detection) and reactive solutions (incident response tooling, compliance-driven risk controls)

- Build AI-native risk systems that leverage fleets of agents to automate complex detection and response workflows, significantly reducing the need for manual intervention

- Strengthen the team by mentoring engineers, conducting rigorous code reviews, writing technical design documents for complex systems, and championing engineering best practices across the codebase

- Own system quality and operational excellence by proactively addressing technical debt, driving bug triaging, and leading incident response and post-mortems to ensure platform reliability

Required Skills and Experience:

- 5+ years of backend software engineering experience with a track record of delivering complex, high-impact systems in production environments

- Deep proficiency in backend languages (Go, Ruby, Python, or Java) with demonstrated experience designing distributed systems including microservices, event-driven architectures, and REST/GraphQL APIs

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and working architectures, driving technical clarity across engineering, product, and data science teams

- Track record leading end-to-end projects with long-term impact, including scoping, design, implementation, monitoring, and mentoring other engineers through the process

- Experience leading incident response, conducting post-mortems, and driving measurable operational improvements in high-availability systems

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hinge Health is a digital health company focused on delivering evidence-based solutions for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain. By combining personalized exercise therapy with virtual care, Hinge Health helps people manage and reduce chronic pain while improving quality of life and reducing healthcare costs.

The Financial Systems team builds and operates the billing and financial infrastructure that powers how Hinge Health makes money. Our systems support the movement of revenue-critical data across products, payers, and internal financial workflows. As Hinge Health expands into new products such as HingeSelect, introduces more complex payment models, adds multi-payer integrations, and grows globally, we need engineers who can build systems that are correct, observable, secure, and resilient at scale.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is excited to work on high-impact financial systems where correctness and reliability matter. You will help design the technical foundations for billing and financial workflows, improve the traceability of money-related data, and make it easier for our product, operations, and Finance partners to deliver a seamless experience for members and customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes a systems-thinking approach to problems involving data integrity, integrations, operational workflows, and long-term maintainability. You care about the details, understand the customer impact of financial systems, and take ownership from design through production operation.

Backend engineers at Hinge Health contribute to their team’s success by architecting and implementing end-to-end solutions, well-tested and performant APIs, and durable data models. You will profile systems to stay ahead of scaling bottlenecks, participate in thoughtful and constructive code reviews, and help maintain a high engineering bar.

We practice continuous deployment and expect owner-operators to support the systems they build in production. Our production systems rely on Golang, gRPC, AWS, Postgres, Redis, and Temporal. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance posture reflects the standards required for healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.


WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Deliver large projects across billing and financial workflows, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

 - Design and evolve reliable services, APIs, and data models for revenue-critical systems, including billing flows, payment-model changes, payer integrations, and financial data movement.

 - Build for correctness and traceability by establishing clear data ownership, durable workflows, idempotent processing, strong validation, and actionable audit and operational signals.

 - Break down complex, cross-functional problems into manageable tasks, enabling steady delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents and data discrepancies.

 - Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Data, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, roadmap technical strategy, and balance short-term delivery with long-term system health.

 - Improve the maintainability, availability, performance, and observability of financial systems, including developer tooling and operational runbooks.

 - Mentor and support junior engineers through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, design feedback, and knowledge sharing.

 - Communicate technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners, and document decisions and workflows so they remain understandable as the team grows.

 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate engineering and operational processes and enhance product capabilities, while preserving appropriate review and control for financial workflows.

 - Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software development experience.

 - 2+ years of experience with at least one programming language.

 - 2+ years of experience across the full software development life cycle, from design through production support.

 - Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Golang, Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

 - Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, data models, and asynchronous or distributed workflows.

 - Experience working with relational databases and integrations where data integrity, failure handling, and observability are important.

 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building billing, payments, revenue, accounting, claims, or other financial systems.

 - Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and scalable cloud services.

 - Experience with Golang, Python, gRPC, Postgres, Redis, Temporal, AWS\

 - Experience improving data quality, operational visibility, incident response, or developer tooling for critical systems.

 - Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers.

 - Experience with AI technologies for software design, coding assistance, or process automation.

title: Software Engineer (L3) Email
description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer, (L3) Email

About the job

This position is a critical engineering role within Twilio SendGrid, requiring a hands-on engineer capable of developing, deploying, and managing highly available, massive-scale distributed systems.

Our systems regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday, and our throughput requirements continue to scale rapidly. As an L3 engineer, you will act as a key driver of execution within our core services. You will be heavily involved in modernizing our backend systems, optimizing our extensive Go-based microservices, and contributing to the design and reliability of our dual-cloud infrastructure span across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

- WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Architect and ship reliable, high-velocity features that handle critical traffic with low end-to-end latency. Partner closely with product management and technical leadership to break down complex system requirements into manageable, iterative milestones.

- BE AN OWNER (CODE QUALITY): Drive rigorous code reviews and push for maintainable patterns in our Go codebase, ensuring high testing standards (unit, integration, and component testing) are executed across the team.

- BE AN OWNER (INFRASTRUCTURE & OBSERVABILITY): Manage and enhance cloud configurations across AWS and Azure environments utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Ensure deep observability coverage by standardizing metrics, alerts, and distributed tracing across core data pipelines.

- CHAMPION ENGINEERING HEALTH: Advocate for a clean architectural foundation. Proactively identify technical debt, system bottlenecks, and single points of failure (SPOF), balancing feature delivery with critical platform refactoring.

- MENTOR AND LEAD: Foster a collaborative environment by mentoring junior engineers, leading technical sprint planning, and sharing expertise across distributed engineering nodes.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

- Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating resilient backend services at scale.

- Modern Development Workflow: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate code generation, automate testing, and streamline debugging workflows.

- Language Proficiency: Strong, hands-on production experience writing clean, idiomatic, and highly concurrent Go (Golang), Java or Python.

- Cloud Infrastructure: Solid experience deploying and managing production workloads in cloud environments—ideally with deep exposure to AWS core services (such as EC2, S3, Aurora, or DynamoDB) AND Microsoft Azure equivalents (such as Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, or Cosmos DB).

- Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for provision-level automation and maintaining environment parity.

- Distributed Systems: Strong theoretical and practical understanding of distributed datastores, caching layers, and asynchronous event streaming (e.g., Kafka or similar queuing ecosystems).

- Systems Mindset: Strong foundational background in computer science fundamentals, data structures, and building self-healing cloud architectures.

Desired:

- Prior experience managing high-throughput applications running inside containerized infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Familiarity with database migration pathways (e.g., transitioning traditional on-prem/relational datastores to managed instances like AWS Aurora).

- Experience implementing OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing systems across decoupled microservice platforms.

- Direct experience handling constraints related to network topology, proxy layers, or mail transfer agent (MTA) protocols.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

- Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $138,700 - $173,400

- Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $146,800 - $183,600

- Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $163,100 - $203,900.

- This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 12/31/2026, but may change based on business needs. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

. 

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer on GitLab's Subscription Lifecycle team within Monetization, you'll build the frontend experiences and backend services customers use to view and manage subscriptions, renew products, configure auto-renewal, and manage billing accounts. Your work will span renewals, overages and reconciliations, subscription visibility, and budget and reservation management, keeping subscription, billing, and account data accurate and reliable. - Contribute to the technical design and implementation of new subscription lifecycle capabilities.

- Integrate subscription lifecycle workflows safely with billing, customer account, and internal admin systems.

- Write maintainable, well-tested code and follow engineering practices for rollout safety and monitoring.

- Familiarity integrating with third-party billing or customer relationship management systems, such as Zuora, Salesforce, or Stripe, is a plus, not a requirement.

- A focus on safe, incremental delivery given the revenue and customer impact of this work.

title: Software Engineer, Backend  (3-5 years) Lending
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our engineering team. In this role, you will play a critical part in designing and building robust, highly scalable distributed systems. You will collaborate closely with product leadership, mentor junior team members, and take immense ownership of complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
- System Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web-based applications. Create architectural abstractions and technical contracts with a strict adherence to the separation of concerns.

- Problem Solving & High-Level Design: Drive solutions for high-level business and technical problems. Lead functional modeling, module decomposition, and system design initiatives.

- Architectural Evolution: Implement incremental changes to the existing architecture and conduct comprehensive impact analyses.

- Performance Optimization: Profile, tune, and improve performance across large-scale distributed systems.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business features into technical capabilities. Lead the execution of medium-sized projects and structure workflows into distinct phases to ensure predictable delivery.

- Stakeholder Alignment: Work with broader stakeholders to track the impact of deployed projects and features, proactively iterating on them for continuous improvement.

- Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers, foster a collaborative team culture, and promote engineering excellence.

Required Qualifications
- Education: B.Tech, M.Tech, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of solving problems at scale.

- Programming Expertise: Extensive experience in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C, C++). Exceptional coding skills with the ability to fluently translate design into maintainable, scalable, and unit-tested code.

- Concurrency: Strong hands-on experience with multi-threading and concurrent programming.

- System Design: Deep expertise in Object-Oriented Design (OOD), design patterns, and building intuitive module and class-level interfaces.

- Scale & Data Management: Proven experience building highly scalable business applications, handling complex business flows, and processing massive volumes of data.

- Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of relational databases (e.g., MySQL) as well as NoSQL technologies (e.g., HBase, Elasticsearch, Aerospike).

- Engineering Best Practices: Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and experience with the full software development life cycle (SDLC) on a Linux platform.

- Working Environment: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-growth, dynamic startup environment with high levels of ownership and commitment.

title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, Authorization
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.

Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.

You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.

Some examples of our projects:

- Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service

- Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design

What you'll do

- Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.

- Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.

- Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.

- Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.

- Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.

- Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.

- Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.

- Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so proposed changes have a documented rationale and review feedback is addressed asynchronously.

What you'll bring

- Solid experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, typically gained over 2 to 4 years or more.

- Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.

- A security mindset: you treat a permission bug as a security bug and consider who a change could affect before choosing an implementation.

- Experience making careful changes to existing codebases, including incremental refactors and feature-flagged rollouts that preserve existing behavior.

- Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.

- Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.

- Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.

- Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.

We welcome transferable experience from adjacent domains such as identity, policy engines, and platform security.

About the team

We work in a fully asynchronous organization, with most decisions made in documents or merge requests rather than meetings.

GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our values include collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency. We expect all GitLab team members to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platforms
description:

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. 

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer who excels at building high-performance distributed systems and thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. You'll be working on cutting-edge data infrastructure challenges that directly impact how Fortune 500 industrial companies manage their most critical operational data.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

- Platform Ownership: Design, build, and operate the core serverless execution engine and Workflows orchestration layer that serve as foundational primitives for CDF’s AI and automation capabilities.

- Reliability Engineering: Own uptime, latency SLOs, and incident response for platform services ensuring Functions execute deterministically and Workflows progress without data loss or silent failures.

- Scalability: Architect for multi-tenant & multi-cloud, high-throughput workloads. Design scheduling, queueing, and retry mechanisms that degrade gracefully under pressure.

- API Design: Define and evolve clean API-first architecture, versioned REST and event-driven APIs that downstream engineering teams and external customers depend on.

- Observability: Instrument services with distributed tracing, structured logging, and alerting (Open-telemetry / Prometheus / Grafana / Honeycomb stack) so failures surface before customers notice.

- CI/CD & Testing: Champion test automation - unit, integration, and smoke tests and maintain deployment pipelines that ship to production with confidence.

- Performance: Profile and resolve bottlenecks in execution throughput, cold-start latencies, and cross-service call chains driving a “snappy” platform experience for industrial workloads.

- Cost Efficiency (Bonus): Model compute and storage costs for functions execution; identify and implement optimizations that reduce cloud spend without sacrificing reliability.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

- 6–8 Years of Engineering: Proven track record building and operating production backend services at scale.

- Expertise: Deep mastery of JVM languages (Kotlin preferred, Java acceptable), Python(FastAPI), distributed systems patterns, and cloud-native service design (Kubernetes, Azure, GCP, AWS, Private cloud).

- Workflow & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with workflow engines (Conductor, Apache Airflow, or equivalent) and event-driven architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub).

- Data & Storage: Comfortable working with relational databases (PostgreSQL) & non-relational databases, object storage(Data-lakes), and caching layers (Redis) in multi-tenant environments.

- Observability Stack: Practical experience with Open-telemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana for instrumentation and operational insight.

- ML Platform Exposure: experience supporting ML workloads & notebooks in production, whether through job scheduling, resource management, experiment tracking integration, or model serving infrastructure.

- Contextualisation Domain (Bonus): Familiarity with industrial knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, or NLP/CV pipelines as they relate to industrial asset data is a strong differentiator.

- Full-Stack Awareness (Bonus): Familiarity with React or TypeScript is a plus for consuming and dogfooding your own platform’s developer tooling.

- The Platform Thinking Spirit: A passion for building composable, well-documented, and automated platform systems that empower other engineers including ML engineers to build faster.

Good to have

ML Platform & Contextualisation:

- ML Workload Support: Build and extend platform primitives compute scheduling, environment management, and secrets handling, that enable ML engineers to run model training, fine-tuning, and batch inference jobs reliably.

- Contextualisation Pipelines: Support the engineering infrastructure behind Cognite’s Contextualisation capabilities (entity matching, asset hierarchy inference, P&ID parsing) by ensuring the platform can orchestrate long-running, GPU-aware, and data-intensive ML workflows without manual intervention.

- Vector & Embedding Infrastructure (Bonus): Familiarity with serving or storing vector embeddings to support semantic search and RAG-based contextualisation use cases.

- Model Lifecycle Awareness: Understand model versioning, A/B experiment tracking, and the boundary between platform concerns and ML framework concerns, so the platform stays lean while ML teams stay unblocked.

Learn more about us

- Impact 2025

- Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot

- We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

title: Senior System Software Engineer – Accelerated Microservices and Libraries
description:
We are looking for a senior software engineer to contribute to building accelerated microservices and libraries for our harnesses and agents. In this role, you will be part of an engineering team designing and developing microservices and libraries and optimizing these for relevant metrics. 
 
What you will be doing: 
- Contribute to design and development of accelerated microservices and libraries 
- Collaborate with peer engineering and Product Management teams to understand requirements and translate these into deliverables across milestones. 
- Design, develop, and maintain real-time vision-language model inference microservices, from video ingestion and preprocessing through model serving and downstream integration. 
- Develop automated functional, accuracy, and performance regression tests, and own component readiness through integration, release, and post-release debugging. 
- Profile and optimize end-to-end latency, throughput, GPU memory usage, and concurrent user capacity across platforms. 
 
What we need to see: 
- Masters or Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or related engineering field 
- 8+ years of overall experience in software development , a strong technical foundation in software design principles and strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python. 
- Hands-on experience building microservices using containers, REST APIs, and asynchronous messaging. 
- Hands-on experience integrating and serving computer vision and vision-language models in production. 
- Understanding of real-time video processing and the tradeoffs among latency, throughput, and resource utilization and strong debugging skills. 
- Experience evaluating model quality and diagnosing accuracy or performance regressions across model, preprocessing, and inference-runtime changes. 
 
Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
- Experience delivering end-to-end video AI applications, including video ingestion, inference, tracking, analytics, and downstream integrations, using technologies such as RTSP and FFmpeg. 
- Background with NVIDIA DeepStream, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, CUDA, or comparable technologies. 
- Experience optimizing and profiling GPU inference pipelines, including batching, memory management, and concurrent model execution. 
- Experience with stateful streaming inference, KV-cache management, batching, quantization, and their impact on serving performance. 
- Experience profiling GPU applications with tools such as NVIDIA Nsight Systems and deploying inference services across x86 and ARM platforms. 

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate people in the world working for us. Are you a creative problem solver with a passion for solving real-world problems with AI? If so, we want to hear from you.

description:
Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI?

Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time.

Why join us

We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.

About the role

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.

If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us!

RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless.

Your Team's Impact

Python & C++ Senior Software Engineer – Data Access (FIP)
FactSet is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Access team — the single, powerful entry point to the FactSet Intelligence Platform (FIP). This is where every interaction begins: AI agents & tools, internal analytics, and client-facing APIs all connect through one unified endpoint and receive responses in a consistent, structured envelope enriched with provenance, source attribution, and entitlement transparency. Operating at the very front of FactSet's data ecosystem, you'll define this client-facing interface and orchestrate the systems behind it, delivering data with exceptional speed, security, reliability, and precision.

The platform handles immense volumes of low-latency requests, so strong engineering discipline is essential — you'll apply best practices in distributed systems, scalability, and performance to build infrastructure that is both resilient and efficient. It's a unique opportunity to shape a critical layer of FactSet's architecture, one that directly shapes the client’s experience and enables the next generation of intelligent applications. If you're passionate about building high-performance systems, simplifying complex data interactions, and making a measurable impact at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do
- Design, develop, and deploy the Data Access interface that defines how clients access data.
- Implement query patterns and APIs that balance flexibility, performance, and security.
- Enforce entitlements to ensure clients access only authorized data products.
- Leverage metrics and KPIs to optimize query execution, incorporating caching and performance strategies to meet client SLAs.
- Build observability into the layer — end-to-end request tracing, provenance, and source attribution surfaced in responses.
- Own Data Access products and features, driving bug fixes, performance enhancements, and scalability improvements.
- Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to continuously improve development processes.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical design reviews and architecture decisions for the Data Access layer.
- Participate in a regional on-call rotation to support production system

- Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience building production-grade, client-facing systems.
- Solid understanding of OOP principles and software design patterns.
- Experience with API design and building orchestration layers across multiple backend systems.
- Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively, with experience leading technical initiatives.
- Passion for designing and implementing efficient, scalable, and maintainable software.

- Experience with multithreaded programming, low latency, and high-availability systems.
- Knowledge of query engine architecture, parsers, compilers and interpreters.
- Experience implementing caching strategies (Redis, Memcached) for query results and metadata.
- Experience with service-oriented architecture and microservices design.
- Understanding of distributed systems and handling failures gracefully across service boundaries.
- Experience working with large-scale data systems and balancing latency, throughput, and cost.
- Background with rate limiting, throttling, and client quota management.
What's In It For You
- At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: - The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
- Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.

- Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging. 

- Learn more about our benefits here. Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. title: NetZhero Engineering Lead
description:
1. About NetZhero

NetZhero is developing India's foremost ESG and carbon intelligence platform — an integrated, three-tier system comprising the ESG Compliance Suite, the Carbon Intelligence Module, and the Agri-Forestry Credit Generator. The platform translates complex regulatory frameworks — including the GHG Protocol, BRSR, TCFD, and Verra VCS — into structured, auditable software, enabling enterprises to measure, manage, and report on their sustainability obligations with precision and confidence.

NetZhero operates with a lean, high-ownership engineering team committed to technical rigour, long-term architectural thinking, and delivery discipline. The Engineering Lead is a central and defining role within this team.

2. Position Overview

NetZhero is seeking an experienced Engineering Lead to provide both technical leadership and direct, hands-on engineering contribution across the full lifecycle of the platform. This is a dual-function role: the successful candidate will be expected to contribute actively to feature development, architecture, and code delivery while simultaneously providing technical direction, mentorship, and engineering governance to the broader team.

This position is not a purely managerial appointment. NetZhero requires an Engineering Lead who leads by technical example — writing production-quality code on a regular basis, making and owning architectural decisions, and holding the team to a high standard of engineering craft. Candidates who seek to move away from active development are not suited to this role.

The Engineering Lead will work in close collaboration with Product, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to translate the platform's governance, materiality assessment, and Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) requirements into reliable, scalable, and well-structured software.

3. Key Responsibilities

3.1 Hands-On Engineering and Feature Development
- Contribute production-ready code across the full technology stack on a regular and sustained basis, functioning as a primary delivery contributor and not solely in a review or oversight capacity.
- Assume end-to-end technical ownership of significant features and modules across the ESG Compliance Suite, Carbon Intelligence Module, and Agri-Forestry Credit Generator — encompassing design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
- Design and implement data models, API contracts, and service boundaries that underpin the platform's ESG-pillar analytics engines, MRV workflows, and carbon credit calculation pipelines.
- Provide direct technical resolution when complex engineering challenges arise, actively engaging with the problem rather than escalating without contribution.

3.2 Architecture and Technical Direction
- Establish and document architectural decisions for the platform's cloud-native services, ensuring that scalability, security, service ownership, and long-term maintainability are addressed as the team grows.
- Apply appropriate design discipline for the regulatory environment in which the platform operates — with specific attention to auditability, data lineage, versioned calculation logic, and the production of structured outputs suitable for third-party verification.
- Evaluate open-source frameworks and third-party tooling systematically, favouring proven, well-supported components and contributing improvements upstream where appropriate.

3.3 Artificial Intelligence and Agentic Capabilities
- Lead the engineering design and delivery of the platform's agentic AI capabilities, developed using LangGraph, Ollama, and QLoRA fine-tuning workflows, in support of governance automation, double-materiality assessment, and MRV use cases.
- Integrate AI-assisted development tooling — including coding assistants and automated code review systems — into the team's standard development workflow to improve delivery velocity and early defect detection.
- Identify, evaluate, and implement AI and machine learning features that deliver predictive and decision-support intelligence to end users within the ESG and carbon intelligence modules.

3.4 DevOps, Reliability, and Cloud Infrastructure
- Design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines across all platform services, ensuring consistent, repeatable, and automated delivery.
- Own platform reliability, including uptime commitments, observability instrumentation, incident response protocols, and alerting configurations that enable proactive issue identification.
- Manage cloud infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code practices, maintaining cost-efficiency and appropriate environment sizing as platform usage and team scale increase.

3.5 Engineering Quality and Team Development
- Establish, communicate, and enforce code review standards, testing expectations, and coding conventions across the engineering team — functioning as an active reviewer and not merely as a standard-setter.
- Provide structured technical mentorship to engineers across full-stack, cloud, and AI-assisted development disciplines, treating the growth of team capability as a core professional responsibility.
- Define, monitor, and act on engineering quality indicators including test coverage rates, defect escape rates, and code review turnaround times, using these metrics to inform continuous process improvement.

3.6 Delivery Management and Stakeholder Communication
- Monitor and report on engineering delivery health using recognised metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time for changes, and change failure rate, ensuring delivery remains predictable and risks are surfaced early.
- Communicate technical progress, architectural trade-offs, and delivery status to product and business stakeholders in a clear, structured, and timely manner.
- Contribute to the growth and culture of a high-ownership engineering team, maintaining an appropriate balance between delivery speed and the engineering discipline required within a regulated compliance domain.

4. Required Qualifications

- Experience: A minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 to 3 years in a technical lead or senior engineering lead role that involved active coding alongside team leadership and architectural responsibility.
- Continued Technical Contribution: Demonstrated commitment to ongoing, regular production coding in recent roles; candidates who have transitioned to exclusively managerial responsibilities are not eligible for this position.
- Full-Stack Proficiency: Substantive, hands-on expertise across the complete technology stack, including React and Next.js on the frontend and Node.js and Python on the backend, with the capability to work effectively at any layer without requiring specialist assistance.
- Cloud and DevOps Competency: Practical, proven experience with cloud platform operations, containerisation technologies, CI/CD pipeline management, and Infrastructure as Code; a demonstrated record of owning production reliability in a professional context.
- Applied AI and Agentic Systems: Demonstrated experience incorporating AI-assisted tools into software development workflows, with preferably direct exposure to building agentic or large language model-powered product features, including familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph and fine-tuning approaches including LoRA or QLoRA.
- Engineering Quality Leadership: A verifiable track record of improving engineering quality standards within a team through active code review, structured mentorship, and the establishment of practices that endure beyond individual projects.
- Stakeholder Communication: The ability to communicate effectively and independently with product management, technical architecture, and business stakeholders, translating complex engineering considerations into clear, actionable information.

5. Preferred Qualifications

- Professional exposure to ESG, carbon accounting, or climate technology domains, including working knowledge of frameworks such as the GHG Protocol, BRSR, Verra VCS, or comparable standards.
- Experience designing and operating data-intensive platforms in which calculation accuracy, data lineage, and auditability are non-negotiable requirements.
- Contributions to open-source software projects or published technical writing that demonstrates depth of expertise and engagement with the engineering community.
- Familiarity with spatial or geospatial data systems with relevance to agri-forestry carbon sequestration analysis and land-use modelling.

6. Technical Environment

Frontend
React.js, Next.js
Backend
Node.js, Python
AI & Agentic
LangGraph, Ollama, LoRA / QLoRA Fine-Tuning Workflows
Cloud & Infra
Microsoft Azure / AWS / GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform (or equivalent IaC)
DevOps & SRE
GitHub Actions (or equivalent CI/CD), Prometheus / Grafana (or equivalent observability stack)
AI-Assisted Dev
GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent AI coding and review assistants
Data
Relational (SQL) and Non-Relational (NoSQL) databases

7. What NetZhero Offers

- The opportunity to engineer a platform of genuine societal significance — ESG and carbon intelligence infrastructure at a moment of substantial and growing regulatory and market demand.
- Significant technical autonomy and ownership from the outset, with direct influence over architectural decisions and platform direction.
- A professional engineering culture that prioritises code quality, peer review discipline, and the continuous development of team capability.
- Competitive total compensation commensurate with experience, a flexible hybrid working arrangement, and the prospect of professional growth within a company at a consequential stage of its development.

title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Full Stack Software Engineer

Location – Bangalore

Work Arrangement – Hybrid

What We Do At Weir

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your impact

You’ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

What You’ll Do

- Software Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy backend services, frontend applications, and integrations with a strong focus on maintainability, performance, security, and usability. Daily work involves hands-on coding primarily in .NET / ASP.NET Core, Node.js, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Success means delivering secure, scalable, and production-ready software that meets functional and operational requirements.
- Low-Code Platform Contribution: Spend about 20% of your time contributing to development within a low-code digital twin and application platform (such as XMPRO), including solution configuration, application logic, and integration of custom components. While prior experience with XMPRO is not required, familiarity with similar tools like Grafana or Tableau is valuable.
- Frontend Engineering: Lead frontend development (approximately 40% of the role) using React and Next.js or similar frameworks, building user-friendly, consistent, and maintainable UI components. Flexibility is essential as requirements evolve during development.
- Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership through hands-on development, mentoring team members, and fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous learning. While architectural skills are a plus, the primary focus is on strong software engineering execution.
- Collaboration & Agile Delivery: Work closely with cross-functional teams including product owners, DevOps, QA, and other engineers in an agile environment to refine requirements and deliver high-quality software.
- Release & Deployment: Support modern release practices such as feature flags, blue-green deployments, and production readiness, working with containerized applications and cloud-hosted environments.
- Travel Requirements: Some international travel may be required depending on current guidelines, with flexibility to work non-standard hours due to the global nature of the role.
- Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

What You’ll Bring

Must-haves:

- Excellent hands-on experience in full stack software development with expertise in .NET / ASP.NET Core, Node.js, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- Proven ability to develop backend APIs, frontend components, and integrations in collaborative, agile teams.
- Experience or exposure to low-code or configurable application platforms such as XMPRO, Grafana, Tableau, or PI Vision, with a strong willingness and ability to learn new tools quickly.
- Excellent communication skills to clearly explain technical concepts and collaborate effectively across diverse team.

Nice-to-haves:

- Experience with software design and architecture practices including clean architecture, domain-driven design, and secure coding.
- Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, and cloud-hosted deployments.
- Background in industrial digital, IIoT, or data-intensive systems, especially in mining, minerals processing, or heavy industry sectors.
- Additional programming skills in languages like Go or Python.
- Prior experience in technical leadership or mentoring roles.

Why join Weir?

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

Benefits

- Competitive pay
- Career development and learning support
- Access to global inclusion networks
- Regional and team-specific benefits
- Sharebuilder scheme
- Wellness support for you and your family
- Collaboration with global teams
- Study support

Senior Frontend Engineer.

6+years _Hybrid -Bangalore

**Responsibilities**

- Architect and develop modern web applications using Next.js 14+ features, including App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, Streaming SSR, and Parallel Routes.

- Collaborate on schema design, indexing strategies, and query optimization for frontend-driven data access.
- Containerize Next.js applications using Docker with multi-stage builds and standalone output mode.
- Deploy and manage applications on AWS ECS using task definitions, service configurations, and auto-scaling.
