- Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
- Manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
- Integrate with AWS services including RDS PostgreSQL, S3, CloudFront, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, WAF, SQS, and SNS.
- Implement frontend observability through structured logging, error tracking, and performance monitoring.
- Configure container-level monitoring and metrics for ECS workloads.
- Apply security best practices, including CSP, CORS, input sanitization, XSS and CSRF protection, and dependency scanning.
- Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance using automated testing tools.
- Lead frontend architecture decisions and document them through architecture decision records.
- Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
- Translate design mockups into pixel-perfect, responsive implementations.
- Stay current with updates in Next.js, React, and AWS services.

**Required Skills**

- 6+ years of professional frontend development experience, with 3+ years building production applications in Next.js.
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, including generics, discriminated unions, type guards, utility types, and strict mode.
- Deep expertise in React, including hooks, context, suspense, concurrent features, server components, and state management tools such as Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or TanStack Query.
- Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, including task definitions, Fargate, ALB, and auto-scaling.
- Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including SQL queries, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, indexing, migrations, and ORM usage.
- Experience with Docker, including production Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and Docker Compose.
- Strong knowledge of modern CSS, including Tailwind CSS, CSS Grid, Flexbox, and responsive design.
- Experience building CI/CD pipelines for containerized frontend deployments.
- Strong understanding of frontend security, performance optimization, and accessibility best practices.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, backend engineers, DevOps teams, and product stakeholders.

- Experience with Next.js 14+ advanced features such as Server Actions, Streaming SSR, and Parallel Routes.
- Experience with GraphQL integration and API middleware design.
- Familiarity with observability tools such as Sentry and Datadog RUM.
- Experience with AWS services such as CloudWatch, WAF, S3, CloudFront, ElastiCache, SQS, and SNS.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
- Familiarity with accessibility testing tools such as axe-core and Lighthouse CI.
- Experience with architecture documentation and technical mentoring.

description:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh is looking for a talented and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in backend engineering. As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in building the foundation of the world’s first global crypto payments network. In this role, you’ll operate across the full stack, from backend systems to user-facing applications. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and design to lead the development of secure, seamless, and scalable financial experiences. As one of our most senior technical leaders, you’ll play a critical role in defining system architecture, mentoring engineers, and influencing product strategy. We’re especially excited to meet candidates based in Bangalore, where you’ll collaborate closely with our core team and help drive our engineering culture from the ground up.

- Develop and maintain backend services and APIs

- Conduct thorough testing, debugging, and prompt resolution of software defects.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies.
- Contribute to code reviews, architectural decisions, and system design.
- Create high-quality, efficient, and reliable code following best practices.
- Optimize performance and scalability of backend systems for handling large data volumes.

Who You Are

- 5-7 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, preferably in the fintech/crypto industry.

- Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and microservices architecture.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure.
- Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.

- Organization & planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.

- Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
- Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
- Experience developing distributed web applications
- Write code that is comprehensible, well-structured, and highly performant
- Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)

Nice to have: BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning

title: Intermediate Backend Engineer, Authorization
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

- Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.

Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.

You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.

Some Examples Of Our Projects

- Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service
- Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design

What you'll do

- Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.
- Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.
- Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.
- Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.
- Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.
- Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.
- Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.
- Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so proposed changes have a documented rationale and review feedback is addressed asynchronously.

What you'll bring

- Solid experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, typically gained over 2 to 4 years or more.
- Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.
- A security mindset: you treat a permission bug as a security bug and consider who a change could affect before choosing an implementation.
- Experience making careful changes to existing codebases, including incremental refactors and feature-flagged rollouts that preserve existing behavior.
- Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.
- Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.
- Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.
- Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.

We welcome transferable experience from adjacent domains such as identity, policy engines, and platform security.

About The Team

We work in a fully asynchronous organization, with most decisions made in documents or merge requests rather than meetings.

GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our values include collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency. We expect all GitLab team members to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
- Flexible Paid Time Off 
- Team Member Resource Groups
- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- Growth and Development Fund
- Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

description:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

What To Know

- Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
- We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
- Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

The Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity to join our Business Technology team. As we move toward an AI-driven delivery model, you will design and build end-to-end workflows that orchestrate ServiceNow, cloud platforms, enterprise systems, and AI agents into autonomous flows that resolve requests from intake through completion.

The ideal candidate starts with business outcomes and economics—understanding current costs and cycle times, defining target states, and designing the fastest path to achieve them. You will re-engineer processes before automating, determine what can be resolved autonomously versus requiring human intervention, and build the integrations that bring these solutions into production.

What you’ll do…

- Orchestrate cross-platform workflows connecting ServiceNow, cloud services, identity systems, and enterprise applications to enable end-to-end request resolution without manual handoffs 
- Build AI-powered request resolution and autonomous operations (intent detection, diagnosis, and resolution), driving deflection before tickets are created 
- Integrate AI agents into workflows using MCP, tools, and orchestration patterns to pull context, take action, and escalate appropriately 
- Re-engineer processes before automating—eliminating unnecessary steps and designing improved workflows 
- Own automation economics and value realization, including measuring cost and cycle time, modeling improvements, and tracking business impact 
- Build and configure solutions on ServiceNow (Flow Designer, Integration Hub, scoped apps, catalog, Now Assist) alongside automation beyond the platform 
- Develop automation outside of ServiceNow using Python and PowerShell for cloud operations, identity management, monitoring, and scheduling 
- Design workflows that balance automation and human oversight—defining approval points, autonomy boundaries, and ensuring systems operate reliably and safely in production 

Who you are?

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field 
- 2–4 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, automation, or ServiceNow development, building production-grade solutions 
- Hands-on experience with ServiceNow development, including workflow automation (Flow Designer), integrations (REST/webhooks), and platform scripting 
- Experience working with authentication (OAuth, bearer tokens) and enterprise data models (e.g., CMDB) 
- Strong automation mindset with the ability to identify what should be orchestrated, automated, or eliminated 
- Solid engineering fundamentals (APIs, system design, data structures, scripting) 
- Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C#, or PowerShell 
- Experience building and integrating systems using REST APIs and enterprise platforms 
- Experience delivering end-to-end automation (design, build, deploy, monitor, measure) 
- Ability to work backward from business outcomes, with a focus on impact and efficiency 
- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders 
- Demonstrated self-learning mindset in a rapidly evolving technology landscape 
- Curiosity to understand root causes—building solutions that address patterns, not just symptoms 
- Strong written and verbal English 

Preferred Skills & Experience

- Experience across additional ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, GRC) 
- Familiarity with ServiceNow capabilities such as Service Portal, UI Builder, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, or Virtual Agent 
- Experience building scoped applications (App Engine) and using automated testing frameworks (ATF) 
- Experience applying AI to workflow automation (e.g., request deflection, automated resolution, intent classification at scale) 
- Exposure to agent-based systems or orchestration patterns (e.g., MCP, tool integration, agent handoffs) 
- Familiarity with human-in-the-loop design, guardrails, and workflow governance

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

The Role

The Frontend Engineer at Razorpay strives to build solid frontend foundations, infrastructure, and top-notch experiences. You are required to work in teams alongside back-end developers, graphic designers, and user experience designers to ensure all elements of web creation are consistent. This requires excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Roles And Responsibilities

- Develop high-quality and responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Implement and maintain frontend frameworks and libraries, such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
- Collaborate with designers to translate wireframes and mockups into functional UI components.
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility and optimize web applications for maximum speed and scalability.
- Write clean, modular, and maintainable code following coding standards and best practices.
- Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the functionality and performance of UI components
- Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to improve code quality and maintainability
- Work closely with backend engineers to integrate frontend interfaces with server-side logic and APIs
- Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide technical insights
- Stay up-to-date with the latest front-end technologies, trends, and best practices, and proactively suggest improvements to the development process
- Champion usability and accessibility, adhering to web accessibility guidelines (e.g., WCAG) and implementing UX principles

Mandatory Qualifications

- A minimum of 1+ years of relevant experience
- Proficient knowledge of any popular JS framework like React, Ember, Angular, or Backbone
- Experience with common front-end tools like SASS/Stylus, Jade, Grunt/Gulp, etc
- Good understanding of REST API
- Ability to build a feature from scratch & drive it to completion
- A willingness to learn new technology, whatever lets you deliver the best product

Good To Have

We also expect the following, but we accept that you can be a great developer without fulfilling the below. So go ahead and apply even if the following isn’t applicable:

- Have a few weekend side projects up on GitHub

description:
What you will be doing (Role Accountabilities)
1) Hands‑On Delivery Leadership (Core)
- Lead delivery for a pod (4–5 engineers) by building software alongside the team—owning design, code, reviews, and integration.
- Break down outcomes into small, deliverable increments and drive execution through modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, code quality gates).
- Ensure the pod delivers working software frequently, with clear definition of done and measurable progress.
2) AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution
- Embed AI tools and techniques across delivery stages (requirements, design, build, test, deploy, operate), using AI to:
- accelerate solution exploration and design options
- generate and refactor code safely
- create unit tests and automation
- perform code review support and documentation
- Set pod‑level working patterns that maximise productivity while ensuring human accountability for final decisions and release readiness.
- Maintain “gate” practices where needed (e.g., quality checks, approvals), consistent with the organizational standards.
3) Technical Direction & Engineering Quality
- Act as the pod’s technical authority: architecture decisions (within guardrails), patterns, component design, and integration approach.
- Own code quality, maintainability, performance, reliability, and security posture for the pod’s deliverables.
- Establish engineering standards inside the pod (branching, coding conventions, review practices, test expectations, CI/CD hygiene).
4) Pod Management (Small Team Leadership)
- Provide day‑to‑day leadership for 4–5 Pod Engineers: task allocation, pairing strategy, unblockers, and prioritisation.
- Coach engineers in AI‑native ways of working, including good prompting habits, evaluation discipline, and safe use of AI tooling.
- Drive continuous improvement: retrospective actions, root cause analysis, and measurable cycle‑time / quality improvements.
5) Stakeholder Alignment & Outcome Ownership
- Work closely with the Senior Manager, AI Engineering and business/product partners to clarify outcomes, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
- Translate business needs into technical work with clear milestones and demonstrable increments.
- Provide transparent progress updates, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
6) Governance, Risk, and Responsible Engineering
- Ensure delivery adheres to security, data protection, and engineering governance expectations.
- Proactively manage risks introduced by AI‑assisted development (e.g., licensing concerns, security vulnerabilities, hallucinated code, weak tests).
- Maintain auditable artefacts where required (documentation, traceability, approvals), aligning to enterprise expectations for controlled delivery.
What Makes This Role Different from a Traditional Tech Lead
- You lead a small pod (4–5 engineers) rather than a large team.
- You are expected to be hands‑on and contribute to the codebase of the pod. Become accountable for delivery outcomes and not primarily people management.
- You use AI as a core delivery engine across SDLC, not as an occasional productivity add‑on.

Essential
- Strong experience as a senior software engineer / technical lead / engineering specialist delivering production systems.
- Solid engineering fundamentals: API design (REST), data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD, secure coding, reliability practices.
- Proven expertise in Java or Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
- Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
- Proven experience leading small delivery groups (e.g., squad/pod/team) and delivering iteratively.
- Practical experience using AI development tools (Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, agent workflows, automated test generation, AI‑assisted documentation).
Desirable
- Experience working in AI‑assisted / agentic delivery models or rapid delivery “pods” / cohort models.
- Familiarity with governance practices that support quality and assurance in delivery environments (e.g., gate reviews, readiness checks).

description:

**Senior Backend / Full Stack Engineer Node.js (with React.js)**  
*Backend-focused (~70%) with React.js frontend (~30%) TypeScript*  
**Experience:** 38 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO) only 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday  
**Location:** Client location, Sector 62, Noida  
**Reports To:** Engineering Lead  
**Role Overview**  
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Backend Engineer (with full-stack ability) who is a strong thinker and independent problem-solver. The role is backend-heavy roughly 70% backend in Node.js (TypeScript) and about 30% frontend in React.js (TypeScript). You will design APIs and data models, build integrations, and take real ownership: given just a feature idea even without a detailed BRD, PRD, or Figma design you should be able to do the R&D, define the requirements and approach yourself, and build it end to end. We want someone with an edge who takes initiative, fills in the gaps, digs into unknowns, and ships.  
**Primary Focus Areas**  
 **Backend (Node.js):** (~70%) Design and build backend services and APIs in Node.js with TypeScript (Express/NestJS) REST APIs, data modeling in PostgreSQL via an ORM, Redis caching, third-party integrations, and security.  
 **Frontend (React.js):** (~30%) Build responsive front-ends in React.js (TypeScript) components, state management, hooks, and API integration; turn a Figma design (or just a rough idea) into working UI.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
 **Backend Development:** Develop and maintain Node.js (TypeScript) services and REST APIs with clean, testable, well-structured code.  
 **Database & ORM:** Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and work through an ORM (Sequelize or Prisma) migrations, relations, indexing, and transactions; write raw SQL when needed.  
¢ **Integrations:** Build integrations with third-party services and APIs (payments, auth providers, messaging, internal systems) reliably and securely.  
¢ **Security & Auth:** Own application security authentication/authorization with Keycloak (JWT/OAuth2/OIDC), input validation, secrets handling, and secure coding practices.  
¢ **Observability & Tracing:** Instrument services with observability and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with a tool like Jaeger / Grafana Tempo / SigNoz) to debug and monitor across services.  
¢ **R&D & Ownership:** Take ownership end to end: from just a feature idea without waiting for a detailed BRD, PRD, or Figma design do the R&D, define the requirements and approach yourself, and build/deliver it independently.  
¢ **Frontend Development:** Build React.js UIs (~30% of the role): reusable components, state management, hooks, and API integration from a Figma design or, when there isn't one, from the idea itself.  
¢ **Caching & Performance:** Use Redis for caching, sessions, or queues to improve performance and scalability.  
¢ **Testing & Quality:** Write unit and integration tests; participate in code reviews and maintain code quality.  
¢ **Collaboration & Mentoring:** Collaborate with product, design, and QA; guide and mentor junior engineers.  
**Required Skills & Experience**  
¢ **MUST HAVE:** (Most important) A strong thinker and self-starter who can take just a feature idea without a detailed BRD, PRD, or Figma design do the R&D, define it themselves, and build it independently with an ownership mindset and an edge.  
¢ 38 years of hands-on backend/full-stack development experience in production environments.  
¢ Strong Node.js with TypeScript building REST APIs and backend services (Express or NestJS). This is the core of the role.  
¢ Solid PostgreSQL / SQL and hands-on experience with an ORM Sequelize or Prisma schema design, joins, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.  
¢ Experience building third-party integrations and secure APIs, with authentication/authorization using Keycloak (JWT/OAuth2/OIDC).  
¢ Working React.js with TypeScript (~30% of the role) hooks, components, state management, and building UI from a Figma design or just an idea.  
¢ Experience with Redis (caching/sessions/queues) or a similar in-memory store.  
¢ Familiarity with observability and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger/Tempo/SigNoz, or similar).  
¢ Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals async/await, promises, and the Node.js event loop.  
**Good to Have**  
¢ Delivery & Ops: Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), and containerized deployments (Docker); troubleshooting production issues and doing RCA.  
¢ GraphQL (Apollo) for API design.  
¢ NestJS and message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka).  
¢ Cloud deployment (GCP / AWS / Azure).  
¢ Testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright).  
¢ NoSQL (MongoDB), WebSockets, and microservices architecture.  
¢ Frontend tooling (Vite/Webpack), Tailwind/Material UI, and performance profiling.  
**Education**  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.  
**What We Offer**  
¢ Ownership of full-stack products end to end backend, frontend, and data.  
¢ A modern TypeScript stack (Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis) and room to improve architecture.  
¢ A collaborative engineering culture and the chance to mentor a junior team.  
¢ Competitive compensation, benefits, and continuous learning support.  
   
*To apply, share your resume along with a brief note on your Node.js + React.js projects (and a GitHub/portfolio link if available).*

title: Software Engineer
description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

You will be part of Postman’s Test Infrastructure team, which powers quality at scale across the company.

At Postman, we believe that quality is everyone’s responsibility. Our team builds the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that enable developers to ship reliable, high-quality products efficiently. From CI/CD pipelines to test frameworks and observability, we focus on improving developer productivity and accelerating feedback loops.

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can help us scale our test infrastructure to meet the next phase of Postman’s growth.

What You’ll Do
- Design and build scalable test infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling with a strong engineering-first mindset
Collaborate with a small, high-impact team to improve system reliability and developer productivity
Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines to optimise performance, cost, and feedback cycles
Develop internal tools and frameworks that simplify testing and improve product quality
Build and enhance test observability systems, including metrics, dashboards, and insights
Drive improvements in test performance, stability, and execution efficiency
Champion best practices in testing, reliability, and developer experience across teams
Continuously explore and introduce new tools, technologies, and methodologies
About You
- 2 to 5 years of experience building large-scale JavaScript/TypeScript applications
Strong fundamentals in software design, systems thinking, and test infrastructure
Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD systems
Experience building or working with test observability, analytics, or reporting systems
Proven track record of owning and delivering complex engineering initiatives
Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineering practices

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

- Investigate, troubleshoot, document, and track product defects, partnering with teammates to drive timely resolution and root cause analysis
- Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the automation framework, improving product quality, test coverage, and release confidence over time
What We’re Looking For
- 2-5 years of professional automation development experience, with real framework-building work, not just script writing
- Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience designing automation frameworks, Pytest-based test suites, CLI tools, and endpoint validation scenarios
- Comfort building and running automation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with an understanding of how platform differences affect framework design
- Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions that improve product quality, reliability, and engineering efficiency

- Equity for all employees

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
 
Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.

- Minimum of 10 years of experience in object-oriented design and programming in a production software environment using Agile development methodologies.

Desired Characteristics:
- Understanding of medical device/medical software development.
- Knowledge of microcontrollers and microprocessors (e.g., ARM), bare-metal firmware and hardware interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART).
- Exposure to healthcare and device communication protocols (e.g., HL7, REST / MQTT).
- Experience with AI-enabled, spec-driven development – using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Kiro) to turn structured requirements and design specifications into code, unit tests and documentation, with human review and traceability appropriate for regulated software.
- Self-starter, motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.
- Ability to work with global cross-functional teams, flexible to accommodate time zones as required.
- Proven ability to quickly ramp up on complex and unfamiliar code, and to pick up new languages/frameworks as needed.
- Proven knowledge of the software development lifecycle, with experience contributing to and leading projects across it – concept creation, new product development, delivery, maintenance and iteration of existing products.

description:
Job Description Summary
We are seeking an experienced Lead Electrical Systems Engineer to lead the design, development, architecture, integration, verification and lifecycle support of complex electronic products and subsystems. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in mixed-signal electronics, embedded processing, power and battery systems, wireless technologies, communication interfaces, PCB development, EMC/EMI, reliability and electrical safety, combined with strong Systems Engineering thinking and product-level problem solving.
The successful candidate will drive engineering deliverables across NPI, Installed Base, VCP, component obsolescence, compliance and advanced technology development, while collaborating with Systems, Software/Firmware, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Service and suppliers. The role requires strong capability in system integration, wireless development and debugging, root-cause analysis and technical leadership, with opportunities to contribute to system architecture, platform development, reusable solutions and AI-enabled engineering transformation.

Job Description
 Roles & Responsibilities
- Lead electrical hardware development end-to-end, from requirements and architecture through detailed design, prototyping, verification, qualification, production release and lifecycle support.
- Translate system and product requirements into electrical requirements, architectures, interfaces and design specifications, ensuring effective requirements flow-down, traceability and verification.
- Design and technically review complex electronic hardware, including mixed-signal, analogue, embedded digital, processor/SoC, power, battery/charging, communication and high-speed interface circuits, including component selection, schematic design and PCB development.

- Own Installed Base and product-lifecycle engineering, including field and manufacturing investigations, CAPA support, reliability improvements, component obsolescence, alternate-part qualification, engineering changes and VCP/design-to-value initiatives.
- Collaborate with Manufacturing, Sourcing and suppliers on DFM/DFT, production testing, yield improvement, supplier transfers, second sourcing, component roadmaps and resolution of manufacturing and supplier-related technical issues.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- 10+ years of relevant experience in electrical/electronic product design and development, with demonstrated ownership of a product, platform or major subsystem.
- Strong hands-on expertise in mixed-signal, analogue, embedded digital, processor/SoC, power, battery/charging and communication circuit design.
- Strong experience in component selection, schematic design, PCB development, board bring-up, integration, testing, debugging and structured root-cause analysis.
- Knowledge and hands-on experience with wireless technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, UWB or other short-range wireless technologies, including hardware integration, RF interfaces, antenna considerations, coexistence and wireless performance evaluation.
- Good understanding of EMC/EMI, signal and power integrity, RF/wireless design considerations, electrical safety, thermal design, reliability, component derating and PCB design principles.
- Experience taking hardware through the complete product lifecycle, including requirements flow-down, architecture/design, verification and qualification, manufacturing transfer, engineering changes and lifecycle support, with demonstrated Systems Engineering and product-level thinking.

FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

Python & C++ Software Engineer 3 – Data Access (FIP)
FactSet is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our Data Access team — the single, powerful entry point to the FactSet Intelligence Platform (FIP). This is where every interaction begins: AI agents & tools, internal analytics, and client-facing APIs all connect through one unified endpoint and receive responses in a consistent, structured envelope enriched with provenance, source attribution, and entitlement transparency. Operating at the very front of FactSet's data ecosystem, you'll define this client-facing interface and orchestrate the systems behind it, delivering data with exceptional speed, security, reliability, and precision.

The platform handles immense volumes of low-latency requests, so strong engineering discipline is essential — you'll apply best practices in distributed systems, scalability, and performance to build infrastructure that is both resilient and efficient. - Design, develop, and deploy the Data Access interface that defines how clients access data.

- Experience with service-oriented architecture and microservices design.
- Understanding of distributed systems and handling failures gracefully across service boundaries.

What's In It For You 
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: 
- The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Company Description Aventis is an ERP-native cross-border B2B payments platform that uses stablecoins and AI-driven routing to make international B2B and supplier payments faster, cheaper, and fully automated from existing finance systems. The platform helps enterprises and mid-market companies reduce cross-border payment costs through lower network fees and improved FX, while cutting settlement times from days to minutes or same-day where supported. Aventis is designed for CFOs, controllers, and AP leaders who want modern, API-like cross-border payments instead of slow, opaque traditional banking processes.
Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad, India

What you'll do:
- Design, build and operate Go services that orchestrate multi-step transactions across internal systems and third-party providers.
- Make every operation safe to repeat: idempotency keys, deduplication and exactly-once effects on top of at-least-once delivery.
- Implement automated retries with exponential backoff and jitter, timeouts and clear handling of terminal failures.
- Build secure webhook ingestion (signature verification, replay protection, durable queuing) and reliable outbound webhook dispatch to partners.
- Own reconciliation, both scheduled batch jobs and event-driven checks, so that internal records always match provider and ledger state.
- Design OLTP schemas in PostgreSQL and keep queries fast through sound indexing, query planning and transaction design.
- Build product features in Next.js and React, with typed contracts shared across the stack.
- Define and evolve infrastructure on AWS ECS and RDS using the AWS CDK in TypeScript.
- Review code, write clear technical designs and help keep patterns consistent across the codebase.

How we build:
- We favour simple, modular design with consistent, repeatable patterns. You'll fit in well if you value:
- Clean domain boundaries - each module owns its data and exposes a small, explicit interface.
- Readable code - written for the next engineer, not to show off.
- Predictable structure - a new service or feature looks like the last one.
- Restraint - no clever abstractions or speculative generality; we add complexity only when a real problem demands it.

What you bring:
- 4–5 years of professional software engineering experience, with full-stack ownership of production systems.
- Expertise in Go for building backend services.
- Expertise in TypeScript, React and Next.js.
- Expertise in PostgreSQL, including OLTP schema design, indexing and query performance tuning.
- Hands-on experience with:
- Service orchestration across multiple internal and external systems
- Idempotency and safe handling of duplicate requests
- Automated retries with backoff
- Secure webhook ingestion and dispatch
- Reconciliation, both scheduled and event-driven
- A track record of choosing simple, consistent designs over clever or over-engineered ones.
- Clear written and verbal communication, especially in design docs and code review.

Nice to have:
Experience in fintech or payments, such as payment rails, ledgers, settlement or PSP integrations.
Experience with stablecoins (a plus, not a requirement).

How we work:
- We hire builders: people who solve hard problems, ship work they're proud of and don't wait to be told what to do.
- Ownership over permission. You'll take a problem from a blank page to production and keep owning it once it's live. If you see something broken, you fix it.
- More responsibility than feels comfortable. We give people real scope early and back them to grow into it. This is a place to do the best work of your career.
- Impact over titles. Good ideas win on merit, not seniority. What you ship matters more than what your title says.
- Hands-on, everyone. Nobody is too senior to write code, debug a production issue or talk to a customer.
- Only build what matters. If it doesn't make cross-border payments faster, cheaper or more reliable for our customers, we don't build it.
- Speed with rigour. We move fast in short cycles, but we're moving money, so correctness is never negotiable.
- Talented peers. You'll work alongside a small, high-calibre team that raises your bar every day.

We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement.

Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform.

- Familiarity with Git and software development workflows.

description:
About the role

We’re looking for a Product Engineer, Fullstack to own product features from idea through implementation and measured outcome.
This is not a role where product hands you a specification and engineering executes it. You’ll work directly with users, product data, design, and the founding team to understand problems, decide what should be built, ship it across the stack, and measure whether it actually worked.
The product sits at the intersection of AI, video creation, and editing, so you’ll work on problems ranging from context-aware agents and editor state to video quality, versioning, and complex creative workflows.

- Features from idea to outcome. Identify the problem, determine the right product response, build it, ship it, and measure its impact.

- Experience building a zero-to-one product or major product feature from an ambiguous starting point.

- Strong product judgment — you think about what should be built and why, not only how to implement it.

- Comfort using user conversations, activation data, and product behavior to make engineering and product decisions.
- Experience using AI coding agents/tools while maintaining strong judgment around architecture, correctness, and system behavior.
- Ability to reduce scope intelligently and ship useful product improvements quickly rather than waiting for perfect solutions.
- Comfortable operating as an individual contributor with significant ownership and limited process or structure.

description:

Kong’s API Management suite includes the Kong Enterprise Gateway, the Konnect SaaS platform, and a variety of Managed Gateways in public clouds, such as AWS, Azure, and GCP. (Source code for deck is at GitHub - Kong/deck: decK: Configuration management and drift detection for Kong. )

Some of the other products that the API Operations toolset includes are:

Terraform-provider: Terraform provider for Kong Konnect - Kong’s SaaS product

SDK for Go: Go SDK for Kong Konnect

SDKs in other languages and tooling to generate SDKs from APIs

API specification and tooling for all products of Kong

Build a CLI-first experience for Kong Konnect

- Design, develop and build the API Operations toolset for Kong, starting with deck.

By balancing high-level system strategy with hands-on technical execution, you will ensure our agentic workflows are scalable, secure, and seamlessly integrated into the enterprise ecosystem.

You will partner with internal teams and external contractors to lead technical reviews, integrations, and delivery execution. - Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and advanced containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
